text:
Clara Yu: quick design sync 1: I'm proposing we let users reorder threshold presets in the SLO editor (drag handle). fig: https://www.figma.com/file/example/presets-reorder Ben Ortiz: reordering is handy. UX question: do presets persist per-project or per-user? that affects where we show the controls. Clara Yu: persisted per-project by default, with an opt-in toggle for personal ordering. keeps teams consistent during incidents. Arman Shah: a11y note: drag handles alone are not keyboard accessible. need a keyboard fallback (move up/down buttons) and ARIA drag support (aria-grabbed / aria-dropeffect is deprecated though). better: implement move up/down buttons with aria-live announcements. ScreenReaderBot: automated-a11y: 1977770000 missing-keyboard-fallback. recommended: provide move buttons and announce "Preset {name} moved to position {n}" via aria-live=polite. Ben Ortiz: agree. Also microcopy: tooltip for drag handle currently says "Drag". change to "Reorder preset" to be clearer for novice users. Clara Yu: good. visual affordances: add a small grip icon + visible focus ring on the handle. but don't hide the move buttons visually; show them on focus/hover for density. Arman Shah: for keyboard controls sample: ```
Preset latency-critical moved to position 2
``` Ben Ortiz: ordering changes can break rollouts if someone expects defaults. add a confirmation toast with undo and note: "This change updates project preset order. Undo?" Keep optimistic UI but allow revert for 7s. Clara Yu: good safety net. Also: discuss mobile: drag is hard on small touch targets. propose long-press to open a compact reorder sheet with up/down buttons. ScreenReaderBot: automated-a11y: 1977770000 long-press has accessibility pitfalls. ensure the compact sheet is a full-screen dialog with role="dialog" and focus trapped. include visible close and clear headings. Arman Shah: color/accessibility: preset chips use low-contrast text on colored background for small labels. ensure contrast >=4.5:1 for chip text or add bold icons and stronger text color. suggested tokens: chip-bg: #F3F7FF, chip-text: #0B2A66 for primary and chip-bg-alt #FFF4F2 chip-text-alt #5B1E17 for critical. Ben Ortiz: one more microcopy ask: when reordering, header says "Presets (custom order)" maybe change to "Presets (project order)" when per-project is active so it's less ambiguous. Clara Yu: action items: Ben - update copy for handle tooltip and header variants; Arman - add keyboard move button patterns + aria-live example; I'll update figma with compact sheet for mobile and chip tokens; DesignOpsBot - create ticket and add to next sprint. :thumbsup: DesignOpsBot: ticket created: design/1977770000 "threshold presets: reorder UX + accessibility". ETA initial PR: 1977770065. https://tickets.internal/1977770000 Ben Ortiz: thanks all, will start on copy now. Clara Yu: thanks team, will follow up with updated frames later today.
